scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --kill-others-on-fail -n server,client "pnpm -C server dev" "pnpm -C client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm run sync:icons && pnpm -C shared build && pnpm -C scenarios build && pnpm -C server build && pnpm -C client build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C shared typecheck && pnpm -C scenarios typecheck && pnpm -C server typecheck && pnpm -C client typecheck
scripts.build:client: pnpm run sync:icons && pnpm -C client build
scripts.pack:all: pnpm run pack:win && pnpm run pack:linux && pnpm run pack:win-exe
